collection_method: Elsevier Scopus Search API (ISSN 0144-8617, DOCTYPE=ar) paged search (query 'ISSN(0144-8617) AND DOCTYPE(ar)', sort=-coverDate, 625 most-recent entries scanned) to find 32 unseen candidates; Elsevier Abstract Retrieval API used per-DOI but returned metadata only (no abstract text under this API key's entitlement); PubMed E-utilities (ESearch by pubmed-id from Scopus records, and by journal+date-range) used to cross-verify PublicationType (Review vs Journal Article) and to retrieve full abstract text. 14 Articles-in-Press (Vol. 391, cover date 2026-11-01) had no PubMed record yet and were excluded from this run rather than reported without verified abstracts. To reach the 20-article target, PubMed search window was widened progressively (reldate 30 -> 90 -> 730 days) which surfaced a large backlog (~900 unseen, non-review, non-retraction Carbohydrate Polymers records, mostly from Aug 2025 that prior daily runs had not yet processed); after excluding review-type and microbe-biology-centric titles/abstracts, the 20 most recent eligible records (spanning 2025-04 to 2026-08) were selected. A general-purpose research agent was also dispatched via WebSearch to attempt filling in abstracts for the 14 unindexed Articles-in-Press and to find supplementary keyword-based candidates; none of its keyword-based candidates were used directly without independent Elsevier-API verification of title/DOI/date match and seen-list status (2 of 6 agent-suggested DOIs were found to be mismatched on verification and were discarded).
eligible_candidates_found_this_scan: ~900 (from widened PubMed backlog scan) + 14 abstract-pending Articles-in-Press left for a future run
exclusion_criteria_applied: 자격 기준에 따라 다음을 제외했습니다: ① 제목/PubMed PublicationType에 Review·Systematic Review가 포함된 논문(다수의 리뷰형 논문이 후보 풀에서 확인되어 제외), ② Retraction/Corrigendum 등 정정·철회 공지, ③ 핵심 주제가 세균·곰팡이·효모 등 미생물 자체의 생물학적 특성, 균주 개발, 배양·발효 공정 최적화인 논문(예: 특정 유전자 조작을 통한 미생물 균체외다당류 생산 균주 개량 연구, 세균 O-항원 혈청형 구조 분석 연구 등). 다당류/고분자 소재가 핵심 주제이고 항균성 시험이나 장내미생물 발효 특성 분석이 부가적 평가 항목으로만 포함된 논문(예: 펙틴의 장내세균 발효 특성 분석, 하이드로겔의 항균 시험)은 수집 대상으로 유지했습니다.
